## Pharmacy Notice

Topialyse Cream provides comfort and hydration to sensitive skin prone to dryness.

It is great for skin-maintenance between eczema and dermatitis flare-ups or for lighter-weight nourishment during the summer months.

It can be used by the whole family on face and body.

Its soothing, nourishing formula lasts 48 hours1 to combat the feeling of tight skin for long-lasting, immediate comfort.

Its velvety cream texture moisturises and conditions. its ultra-melting, non-greasy, non-sticky texture means you can get dressed straight away.

Topialyse Cream will become your go-to for comfortable, moisturised skin all year round.

How to use:

Apply morning and evening.

Apply to a clean body, paying particular attention to dry areas.

Ingredients:

Aqua/Water/Eau, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Orbignya Oleifera Seed Oil, Glycerin, C10-18 Triglycerides, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Pentylene Glycol, Glyceryl Stearate Citrate, Glyceryl Stearate Se, Borago Officinalis Seed Oil, Glyceryl Glucoside, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Alpha-Glucan Oligosaccharide, Tocopherol, 1,2- Hexanediol, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Caprylyl Glycol, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Parfum (Fragrance)

Size: 1
